One new row kind, no new DETAILS_KEYS; start and role ride in the target path. Added stage rj-block (rj1-rj6) and case ds2j; updated PINNED_320_ACTIONS for the new row and made ds7f/ds9x reset via _unjournal_return since they relied on delete-and-refile. Sweep with --jobs 4: 334/334 files ok, 16123 cases.
